content.user_title: Optimize AI Context for Long-Running Agents
content.value_statement: Long conversations can exceed context limits, increase cost, and reduce response quality. This skill selects compaction, masking, caching, partitioning, and budgeting techniques.
actual_capabilities: Estimates token usage with a documented character-based heuristic.
Categorizes messages for selective compaction by role, type, and retrieval tags.
Summarizes tool outputs, conversations, documents, and general text with simple heuristics.
Stores and masks verbose observations while retaining retrievable references.
Tracks context budget allocation, utilization, and optimization triggers.
Calculates cache hit metrics and suggests prompt-stability improvements.
limitations: Token estimates are approximate and primarily suited to English text.
Summarization uses simple heuristics and does not guarantee factual completeness.
Observation storage is in memory, bounded by item count, and not persistent.
The utilities do not call model APIs or modify an existing agent framework automatically.

use_cases.title: Extend coding sessions
use_cases.description: Apply token budgets and compaction triggers to preserve decisions during long implementation tasks.
use_cases.target_user: Software developers using AI coding agents

use_cases.title: Control support-agent context
use_cases.description: Mask completed tool outputs while keeping recent evidence available for customer support decisions.

use_cases.title: Evaluate prompt caching
use_cases.description: Measure cache hit rates and identify unstable prompt prefixes that increase cost and latency.

prompt_templates.title: Assess context usage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this conversation. Estimate which context categories consume the most tokens, then recommend one optimization and list information that must remain unchanged.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a focused context assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Create a token budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a context budget for this agent using its context limit and workload. Allocate tokens by category, reserve response capacity, and define warning thresholds.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs explicit limits before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Plan selective compaction
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a compaction plan for the provided message history. Classify content by retention priority, define summaries, preserve active decisions, and estimate token reduction.
prompt_templates.scenario: An agent session is approaching its context limit.

prompt_templates.title: Architect context optimization
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a long-running agent context strategy combining compaction, observation masking, cache-stable prefixes, and sub-agent partitioning. Include triggers, quality checks, recovery paths, and metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced production workflow requires several coordinated optimization methods.

output_examples.input: A support-agent transcript uses 78 percent of its context, mostly from old tool outputs.
output: Primary action: mask tool outputs older than three turns.
Preserve current customer facts, unresolved questions, and recent evidence.
Trigger compaction at 80 percent utilization and review answer quality afterward.

output_examples.input: Repeated requests have a low cache hit rate because timestamps appear near the start of each prompt.
output_examples.output: Move timestamps after the stable instructions and tool definitions. Use consistent formatting, then track cache hit rate across comparable requests.

output_examples.input: A research agent must process several large documents without losing the final synthesis goal.
output_examples.output: Assign each document to an isolated sub-agent. Return concise findings with source references, while the coordinator retains the shared goal and synthesis criteria.

best_practices: Measure token use, quality, latency, and cost before selecting an optimization.
Preserve task goals, user preferences, active decisions, and recent evidence during compaction.
Test thresholds on representative workloads and keep masked content retrievable.
anti_patterns: Do not compact system instructions or unresolved task requirements.
Do not mask recent observations that support active reasoning.
Do not add optimization machinery without measuring a real context constraint.

faq.question: Does this skill increase a model context window?
faq.answer: No. It reduces unnecessary context and organizes retained information to use the existing window more effectively.

faq.question: Does the skill call Claude, Codex, or another model?
faq.answer: No. The included utilities use local heuristics and require separate integration with any model API.

faq.question: How accurate is the token estimator?
faq.answer: It uses about four characters per token for English. Use a model-specific tokenizer for production measurements.

faq.question: Can masked observations be recovered?
faq.answer: Yes, while the in-memory ObservationStore retains them. They are removed when capacity eviction occurs or the process ends.

faq.question: When should compaction begin?
faq.answer: The guidance suggests warnings near 70 percent and compaction near 80 percent, followed by quality evaluation.

faq.question: Which information should remain uncompressed?
faq.answer: Keep system instructions, task goals, user preferences, active decisions, recent context, and evidence needed for current reasoning.
